method.selection_rule: strict validation overall-score improvement without measured quality regression; locked_test evaluated after selection
method.notes: Prep received meeting title and pre-meeting sourced facts/file summaries only. This did not exercise the full Listener–Conductor–Diagrammer pipeline.

proposal.append: Prefer predictions grounded in explicit file summaries and sourced facts; do not infer technology switches or replacements from meeting titles or vague questions alone.
proposal.reason: Examples 07 and 06 scored 0.4 because they predicted JWT replacement and UI discussion from weak titles/questions, while sourced summaries only supported impact and login topics.

decision_reason: validation overall score did not improve

Return an empty list if no grounded prediction is possible.
